name: [NOK] AI-Powered Invoice Reminder & Payment Tracker for Finance & Accounting

assignments.name: aiPrompt

parameters.query:
UPDATE invoices 
SET 
  payment_status = 'paid',
  payment_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  payment_amount = {{ $json.body.amount }},
  payment_method = '{{ $json.body.payment_method }}'
WHERE invoice_number = '{{ $json.body.invoice_number }}'
RETURNING *;
